name: Sett
title: the Boss

Q.name: Knuckle Down
Q.description: Sett itches for a fight, gaining 30% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1.5 seconds. Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional 10/20/30/40/50 plus 0.01 + 0.0×AD max Health physical damage.
Q.summary: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

W.name: Haymaker
W.description: Passive: Sett stores 100% of damage taken as Grit, up to 0.5×max HP. Grit decays quickly 4 seconds after the damage was taken. Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a 100% Grit consumed Shield decaying over 3 seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 plus 0.25 + 0.002×bonus AD Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max (varies) damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
W.summary: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

E.name: Facebreaker
E.description: Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing 50/70/90/110/130 + 0.6×AD physical damage and Slowing them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are Stunned for 1 second.
E.summary: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

R.name: The Show Stopper
R.description: Sett grabs an enemy champion and Suppresses them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing 200/300/400 + 1.2×bonus AD plus 40/50/60% of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 99% for 1 second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.
R.summary: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

Passive.name: Pit Grit
Passive.description: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.
Passive.summary: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Juggernaut top laner who stores damage taken as Grit and releases it as a shield and huge true-damage centre punch with W. Wins with E stun and R suppression slam.
strengths: W: shield from Grit + true damage in the centre of the punch
E stun when he grabs on both sides
R suppression slam deals damage based on target's bonus health
Passive health regeneration from missing health
Strong level 1-3 trades with alternating punches
weaknesses: Short range: kited by ranged champions
W centre is easy to dodge
Weak against tanks with heavy health in late game

Passive.notes: Alternating punches; health regen based on missing health.

Q.notes: Move speed toward enemies; next 2 attacks deal max-health damage.

W.notes: Shield from Grit; punch with true damage in centre.

E.notes: Pulls enemies on both sides together; stuns if both sides hit.

R.notes: Grabs and suppresses a champion; slam slows.
